 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    bg = max(set(x for row in grid for x in row), key=lambda x: sum(r.count(x) for r in grid))
    # Extend the solid horizontal colored band: a stripe of pattern has blank
    # space after its end, with the next row providing the continuation marks.
    # Find the rows with long runs of non-background pixels and fill the blank
    # region following the row whose pattern is a solid/near-solid band.
    for r in range(h-1):
        vals = [c for c,x in enumerate(grid[r]) if x != bg]
        if len(vals) >= 5 and vals == list(range(min(vals), max(vals)+1)):
            # When the line above/below has the same color pattern beginning
            # here, continuation is the aligned empty suffix at the right.
            start, end = min(vals), max(vals)
            if end < w-1 and grid[r+1][end] != bg:
                pass
    # Task rule: fill the rightward blank continuation of the two patterned
    # rows, indicated by the missing terminal cells after the last colored mark.
    # Detect repeated pair of same non-background shape, then fill suffix on
    # the row that has a full-width colored band across its left portion.
    for r in range(h):
        cells=[c for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]!=bg]
        if len(cells)>=5 and cells==list(range(cells[0],cells[-1]+1)) and cells[-1] < w-1:
            # Only extend where adjacent repeated structure signals the line.
            if r+1<h and sum(grid[r+1][c]!=bg for c in range(cells[0],w))>=2:
                color=grid[r][cells[0]]
                for c in range(cells[-1]+1,w): out[r][c]=color
    return out

 "content": "def transform(grid):
    # Infer corresponding rows in the two separated patterned panels. Fill
    # only the lower copy's missing cells when its row is a partial version of
    # a matching row in the upper panel; new cells use marker color 1.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    occupied = [r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if any(v != bg for v in row)]
    if len(occupied) < 2:
        return out
    # Separate panels by the largest blank-row gap.
    gaps = [(b-a-1, a, b) for a,b in zip(occupied, occupied[1:])]
    _, upper_end, lower_start = max(gaps)
    upper = [r for r in occupied if r < lower_start]
    lower = [r for r in occupied if r > upper_end]
    # Try same row ordering; panels may have equal row counts.
    if len(upper) == len(lower):
        for a,b in zip(upper, lower):
            # If the rows share the same motif/color and lower is a subset,
            # fill the missing occupied positions in lower with 1.
            ua={c for c,x in enumerate(grid[a]) if x != bg}
            lb={c for c,x in enumerate(grid[b]) if x != bg}
            if len(ua & lb) >= 2 and lb < ua:
                for c in ua-lb: out[b][c]=1
    return out

# test
if __name__ == '__main__':
    pass
",
 "cross_profile": false
}
